$comment: Routing table for the pr-self-review skill. Read by scripts/pr-self-review-gate.mjs and referenced (never restated) by SKILL.md. Globs are repo-root-relative, POSIX separators.

lanes.title: Frontend — Next.js / React
invariants: A component never fetches on its own — new endpoint means a hook in src/lib/hooks/ called through src/lib/api.ts. A bare fetch in a component is stop-the-line.
No literal copy in JSX: everything through next-intl + messages/<locale>/*.json.
Pages stay thin; logic lives in src/app/**/_components/<Name>/.
The API base comes from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE, never hardcoded.
Run progress arrives over SSE — don't add polling where a stream already exists.

lanes.title: Backend — Fastify API
invariants: TypeScript ESM: relative imports must carry the .js suffix.
A new module is a plugin plus exactly one line in src/modules/index.ts — there is no autoload.
Routes declare zod params/body; never Schema.parse(req.body) inside the handler.
HTTP never reaches SQL: routes.ts -> service.ts -> repository.ts.
A new external dependency means an adapter plus a getter in platform/container.ts, or it can't be mocked via ContainerOverrides and tests hit the network.
Registration order in app.ts is load-bearing: plugins and the error handler come before modules.

lanes.title: Database — Drizzle schema and SQL migrations
invariants: Migrations do not run on boot; a schema change without a generated migration is a broken deploy.
A hand-edited migration that no longer matches src/db/schema/ will drift silently.
Secrets never live in the DB.
The schema already contains tables for future lessons — an unused table is expected, not dead code.

lanes.title: Review engine — reviewer-core
invariants: No side effects beyond the injected LLMProvider: no DB, GitHub, fs, env or clock. I/O belongs to the caller and arrives as a resolved string.
The public API is src/index.ts only — the server consumes TypeScript source through a path alias, so an export change breaks it instantly with no build step to catch it.
INJECTION_GUARD in prompt.ts is the one shared defense; never swap it for a keyword denylist.
All external content goes through wrapUntrusted.
Grounding is mandatory — a finding that doesn't cite a real diff line is dropped.
The score comes from findings that survived grounding; the model's self-reported score is ignored.
A new prompt section must be an optional slot: empty means the prompt is byte-identical to before.

lanes.title: Tests — unit, integration, e2e flows
invariants: A DB-backed test must use the *.it.test.ts suffix — the unit lane excludes that glob and has no Docker.
Tests are hermetic by default: use server/src/adapters/mocks.ts, never real network or keys. Client tests mock fetch.
An e2e flow is JSON data, not code; the commands are the assertions. Deterministic locators only — never the AI chat command.
Coverage is typological, not line-based: one test per behaviour class, not per line.

lanes.title: Documentation
invariants: Documentation is the source of truth; AGENTS.md points at it and never restates it.
Package conventions live in that package's AGENTS.md, never duplicated at the root.

Doc roles are fixed: README.md is how it works today, docs/ is deep dives, specs/ is what we're building, INSIGHTS.md is why (append-only, newest first, Context/Tried/Chose), LEARNINGS.md is hard-won gotchas (append-only, seven fixed section headings that are never renamed, reordered or added to).
CLAUDE.md is a symlink to AGENTS.md — never a second real file.
In e2e/, specs/ holds the flow tests; feature specs live in e2e/docs/specs/.

lanes.title: Infrastructure — CI, scripts, containers, agent config
invariants: Not a pnpm workspace: four standalone packages, each with its own package.json and lockfile. pnpm install runs inside the package directory, never at the root.
Cross-package code is shared through tsconfig path aliases against TypeScript source — no build step between packages.
CI is path-filtered per package; a new package path needs the matching workflow filter.
server/package.json is skip-worktree, so CI calls pnpm exec vitest directly rather than committed scripts.
scripts/e2e.sh runs on alternate ports (PG 5433, API 3101, web 3100) and must never touch the dev database.
